rationale_text: Case 11280_1001303: a 1.16 cc lesion in the peripheral zone is moderately hypointense on T2W (z=-0.67 relative to same-zone background tissue) with irregular, ill-defined (sphericity=0.45) margins. These measurements are consistent with PI-RADS category 3. Note: this dataset is biparametric (no DCE sequence available); real PI-RADS v2.1 would use DCE as a tie-breaker for a peripheral-zone category-3 lesion (early enhancement can upgrade PZ-3 to PZ-4) -- that assessment cannot be made here, so this category should be treated as a lower bound, not a confirmed 3.
